excerpt: South Korea’s Samsung Electronics Co. is a “demanding customer” for the Netherlands-based ASML Holding N.V. as it is increasing orders for the Dutch company’s extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography systems
notes: Article does not say which Samsung unit buys; Samsung described as the world's No. 1 memory chipmaker, so samsung-memory chosen. Samsung Foundry also buys EUV and may deserve its own edge from another source.
